clue.text: French king to have possession of South African city

parts.note: Hugh Capet was the king of France who founded the Capetian dynasty
to have possession of something is to own it

explanation.surface: A French monarch claims a city in South Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: The Western Cape's port is one of South Africa's capital cities.

clue.text: Edible flower buds cut by pranksters

definitions.meaning: pickled buds of a Mediterranean shrub, eaten as a relish
pranksters cut a caper, a playful frolic or prank

explanation.definitionFit: The pickled shrub buds share a name with frolics or pranks, which people are said to cut.

clue.text: Parson's stand-on pornographic literature!

parts.note: a parson's stand is the raised preaching box in church, and his stand on porn is the denunciation he delivers from it

explanation.surface: A clergyman takes a moral position against smut.
explanation.definitionFit: The raised enclosed platform in a church is where a preacher stands to deliver sermons and moral condemnations.

clue.text: Tendency to have an upright aim

annotationWithheld.why: Tendency to have an upright aim (5): TREND; END is aim, but no reading of 'to have an upright' gives TR, so the clue looks misread and a search found no other text
annotationWithheld.clue: Tendency to have an upright aim

clue.text: They serve people in a queue?

definitions.meaning: restaurant staff who bring food to tables
those standing in line are all waiting

explanation.definitionFit: Restaurant servers and anyone standing in line are both those who wait.

clue.text: Promotion for one of those in flight

definitions.meaning: a rise in rank or position

definitions.text: for one of those in flight
definitions.meaning: each stair in a flight of stairs lifts you one level

explanation.definitionFit: A rise in rank and a single stair climbed in a staircase are both a rise of one level.

clue.text: Answered a summons to appear only to be evicted

definitions.meaning: people who attend when called are said to have shown up
thrown out of one's home

explanation.surface: Someone obeys a summons only to find themselves thrown out.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both attended or showed up and expelled or thrown out.

clue.text: Skip a meal at the end of Lent

definitions.meaning: to skip something is to omit or ignore it

definitions.text: a meal at the end of Lent
definitions.meaning: the Jewish festival with its seder meal falls around Easter, when Lent ends

explanation.surface: Someone decides to miss a dinner just as the Lenten fast finishes.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means ignore or omit, and the Jewish spring festival with its seder falls near Easter.

clue.text: For every one poem is contrary

parts.note: per means for each, as in miles per hour
a verse can be a single poem or piece of poetry

explanation.surface: Each poem, someone grumbles, is awkward and contrary.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone obstinately contrary deliberately behaves unreasonably or against expectation.

clue.text: Arrested for having parked at lay-by

definitions.meaning: police slang for taking someone into custody
a driver who stops in a roadside lay-by has drawn off the road; a lay-by is a British roadside stopping place

explanation.surface: A motorist is nicked for stopping at a roadside lay-by.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both taken into custody and drawn off the road to stop.

clue.text: Times the Queen needed a rubber

parts.note: eras are long periods of time
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: The monarch needed something to rub out her mistakes.
explanation.definitionFit: In British English a rubber is the stationery item that removes pencil marks.

clue.text: Way back a king in Russia

definitions.text: Way back a king in Russia

indicators.note: back says the abbreviation for way is turned round

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: Long ago a monarch ruled the Russian empire.
explanation.definitionFit: The emperor of Russia before 1917 was its autocratic ruler, a kind of king.

clue.text: Rider seen ordering team for a sleigh

indicators.note: ordering signals the letters of rider seen are being arranged afresh

explanation.surface: A rider is seen organising a team to pull his sleigh.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordering' rearranges RIDERSEEN; the plural form is rare but allowed.
explanation.definitionFit: Santa's sleigh is traditionally pulled by a team of these antlered Arctic animals.

clue.text: Revokes endlessly just to elicit a reaction

indicators.note: endlessly means the word revokes loses its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Someone cancels things repeatedly just to provoke a response.
explanation.definitionFit: To call forth a feeling or response is to stir or summon it.

clue.text: Girl in glasses

indicators.note: in says the answer is found within the word glasses

explanation.surface: A girl wears spectacles.
explanation.definitionFit: A Scottish and northern English word for a young woman.

clue.text: I am in a state of exuberance

indicators.note: in says the contraction for I am goes inside a state

parts.note: a nation is a state
I'm is the contraction of I am

explanation.surface: Someone declares themselves bursting with high spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: Liveliness and spirited energy are both senses of vivacity.

clue.text: Rumours heard by American lodgers

indicators.note: heard says the word rumours is spoken and a soundalike results

parts.note: rumours is gossip

explanation.surface: Gossip is overheard by people renting rooms in the States.
explanation.definitionFit: In the US, people renting rooms in a house are called by this term.

clue.text: Little monkey likely to spoil second round of tennis

parts.note: to mar is to spoil
a mo is a moment or second
a set is a unit of play in tennis

explanation.surface: Something likely to ruin the second set of a tennis match.
explanation.definitionFit: A small South American primate with a long tail.

clue.text: Get a slipped disc and retire

definitions.meaning: to strain or injure one's spine
to withdraw, as troops do

explanation.surface: Someone injures their spine and gives up work.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both injure one's spine and withdraw or retreat.

clue.text: Entertaining reason for not letting someone borrow your tool

definitions.meaning: funny or diverting

definitions.text: reason for not letting someone borrow your tool
definitions.meaning: split into three words it is what you say when you are still working with it

explanation.definitionFit: Funny or diverting, and split as a phrase it is the excuse that you still need the tool.

clue.text: Jokes that leave one speechless

definitions.meaning: comic lines
cloths tied over the mouth to silence someone

explanation.definitionFit: Comic lines share a name with cloths tied to stop a mouth.

clue.text: Devout and sober minded prime minister

parts.note: pi is slang for pious
TT means teetotal, so sober

explanation.surface: A pious, abstemious head of government.
explanation.walkthrough: PI is informal British for pious; TT means teetotal. Either William Pitt fits.
explanation.definitionFit: William Pitt the Elder and the Younger both led British governments.

clue.text: Sailor turning up in Malayan boat is properly proportioned

indicators.note: in says the reversed sailor goes inside the boat

parts.note: a proa is a Malay sailing boat

indicators.note: turning up in a down clue means the word for sailor reads upward

parts.note: a tar is a sailor

explanation.surface: A seaman climbs into a boat in Malaya, everything in proportion.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase means in proportion, each share matching its due part.

clue.text: California needs Chinese R nightclub

parts.note: CA is the postal abbreviation for California
Sino- is the prefix meaning Chinese

explanation.surface: California needs a Chinese nightclub.
explanation.walkthrough: The stray R appears to be a printing slip and plays no part.
explanation.definitionFit: A gambling house often doubles as a venue for night-time entertainment.

clue.text: Failing to join the enemy

definitions.meaning: a flaw or shortcoming
to desert to the other side

explanation.definitionFit: A flaw or fault, and as a verb, to desert to the opposing side.

clue.text: A dismal return to the Australian outback

indicators.note: return says the letters of the whole phrase read backwards

parts.note: glum means dismal

explanation.surface: A gloomy homecoming to the bush in Australia.
explanation.definitionFit: Australian slang for remote back country, from the acacia scrub that grows there.

clue.text: Take a holiday and proceed to desert

parts.note: to go on is to proceed
to leave is to desert

explanation.surface: A soldier is told to take time off, then goes AWOL.
explanation.definitionFit: Leave is permitted time off, especially from military service.

clue.text: Turner depicting an old part of Kent

definitions.meaning: a machine that turns wood or metal, not the painter
a former administrative division of the English county of Kent

explanation.surface: A painting by Turner shows an old corner of Kent.
explanation.definitionFit: A turning machine for shaping wood, and a historic division of the county of Kent.

clue.text: Latins agitated for a leader who sent dissidents to …

definitions.text: a leader who sent dissidents to …

indicators.note: agitated signals the letters of latins being stirred up

explanation.surface: Latin people are disturbed by a dictator who exiled dissidents.
explanation.definitionFit: The Soviet dictator sent opponents to labour camps in Siberia.

clue.text: … request seasoning for the crisps

parts.note: split, the phrase asks for the seasoning on crisps that belong to me; whole, it is where the dictator in the previous clue sent dissidents

explanation.surface: Someone asks for seasoning on their potato snacks.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue continues the previous one: Stalin sent dissidents to such places. Crisps are what Americans call potato chips.
explanation.definitionFit: Underground workings where rock sodium chloride is dug were Soviet places of punishment.

clue.text: Capturing the ruler of Dad's Army?

indicators.note: of puts the ruler belonging to the army after it

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve; Dad's Army is a British sitcom about the Home Guard
a king is a ruler

explanation.surface: Seizing the leader of the old Home Guard.
explanation.definitionFit: Seizing or capturing something.

clue.text: Escorted by an unsupportive bridge partner

definitions.meaning: accompanied on a date
in the card game bridge, a partner who bids a different suit removes your bid

explanation.definitionFit: Accompanied on an outing, and in bridge, having one's bid removed by partner.
